### FromLockOptions {#FromLockOptions}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag">interface</span> <code class="sdk-qual">deposits.FromLockOptions</code></div>

```ts sdk-signature
interface FromLockOptions {
  amount?: bigint;
  verify?: boolean | 'attested' | 'full';
  validators?: Array<number | string>;
  chainId?: number;
  publicClient?: PublicClient;
  publicClients?: PublicClients;
  yieldMs?: number;
  bls?: BlsBackend;
}
```

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--fields">

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <code>amount?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">bigint</span> | The deposit amount to return (wei). Required when the lock holds deposit data for more than one amount (Charon's default is 1 ETH and 32 ETH per validator): the SDK never picks one, since each choice sends a different amount of ETH. Without it such a lock throws DEPOSIT_AMOUNT_REQUIRED, whose `details.available` lists the amounts. |
| <code>verify?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">boolean &#124; 'attested' &#124; 'full'</span> | How to run [`cluster.verifyLock`](../cluster.md#verifyLock) first: `true` / `'attested'` (default) checks the lock at level `attested` plus the BLS signatures of the returned validators; `'full'` runs every check; `false` none. |
| <code>validators?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">Array&lt;number &#124; string&gt;</span> | Only these validators, by index in the lock or by group pubkey (default all). Results stay in lock order. |
| <code>chainId?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">number</span> | The chain the deposits are for; the lock's `fork_version` must match it. Set by the client. |
| <code>publicClient?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">PublicClient</span> | For contract-wallet definition signatures during verification (on the lock's chain). |
| <code>publicClients?</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./checks#PublicClients">PublicClients</a></span> | Passed to [`cluster.verifyLock`](../cluster.md#verifyLock): clients by chain id for contract-wallet definition signatures. |
| <code>yieldMs?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">number</span> | Passed to [`cluster.verifyLock`](../cluster.md#verifyLock). |
| <code>bls?</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./checks#BlsBackend">BlsBackend</a></span> | Passed to [`cluster.verifyLock`](../cluster.md#verifyLock). |

</div>

|---|---|---|
| <code>pubkey</code> | <span class="sdk-type">Hex</span> |  |
| <code>status</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="#DepositStatusName">DepositStatusName</a></span> |  |

| <code>beaconStatus?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">string</span> | Raw beacon status; `pending_deposit` for a pubkey only in the queue; absent for `new`. |
| <code>validatorIndex?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">number</span> |  |
| <code>withdrawalCredentials?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">Hex</span> | The registry entry's credentials or, queue only, the ones the validator will be created with: from the Obol API, the first validly signed queued deposit's once every deposit before it is checked (so possibly while `signaturesPending`; absent while an unchecked deposit comes first, or when none is valid); from a source without signature checks, the first queued deposit's. |
| <code>balance?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">bigint</span> |  |
| <code>effectiveBalance?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">bigint</span> |  |
| <code>activationEpoch?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">bigint &#124; null</span> | Registry validators: the activation epoch, or null while none is assigned. Absent when the source does not report it (the interim `/v1/state/:lockHash` answer, an API before deposit-status had it) and for pubkeys not in the registry. |
| <code>exitEpoch?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">bigint &#124; null</span> | Registry validators: the exit epoch, or null while no exit is initiated. Absent as `activationEpoch`. |
| <code>pendingPartialWithdrawals?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">bigint</span> | Registry validators: the sum of their entries in the beacon chain's pending partial withdrawal queue (EIP-7002), wei. Absent as `activationEpoch`. |
| <code>pendingDeposits</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="#PendingDeposit">PendingDeposit</a>[]</span> |  |
| <code>signaturesPending?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">boolean</span> | Obol API: true while the signatures of this queue-only pubkey's queued deposits are still being checked (usually within a slot; [`deposits.status`](../deposits.md#status) re-reads a few times first, see `pendingRetry`). The credentials it will get may already be decided (`withdrawalCredentials` set: every deposit up to the first validly signed one is checked). False for registered and new pubkeys. Absent when the source does not check signatures. |
| <code>credentialsConflict?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">boolean &#124; null</span> | Obol API: whether validly signed queued deposits carry different withdrawal credentials (the first one applies); null while `signaturesPending`. Absent when the source does not report it. |
| <code>credentialsMatch?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">boolean &#124; null</span> | With `expectedWithdrawalAddress`: whether the credentials the validator has (or, queued only, will get: see `effectiveCredentials`) are `0x01` / `0x02` for that address; null when there are none yet, including while undecided (`signaturesPending` with an unchecked deposit first). |

</div>

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag">interface</span> <code class="sdk-qual">deposits.PendingDeposit</code></div>

```ts sdk-signature
interface PendingDeposit {

  signatureValid?: boolean | null;
}
```

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--fields">

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <code>amount</code> | <span class="sdk-type">bigint</span> |  |
| <code>withdrawalCredentials?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">Hex</span> | Absent when the source does not report them: the interim `/v1/state/:lockHash` answer gives only the sum of top-ups queued for a registry validator. |
| <code>signatureValid?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">boolean &#124; null</span> | Obol API, pubkeys only in the queue: whether the deposit's BLS signature is valid (the beacon chain skips queued deposits with an invalid one until a valid one creates the validator); null when not checked (a registered validator's top-up, whose signature does not matter, or while `signaturesPending`). Absent when the source does not check signatures (the beacon fallback, the interim `/v1/state/:lockHash`, an older API); such a deposit is treated as possibly valid. |

</div>

### DepositsModule {#DepositsModule}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag">interface</span> <code class="sdk-qual">deposits.DepositsModule</code></div>

The deposits module bound to a client context.

```ts sdk-signature
interface DepositsModule {
  fromLock: (
    lock: Parameters<typeof fromLock>[0],
    options?: FromLockOptions,
  ) => Promise<LockDeposits>;
  assertDepositData: (
    deposits: readonly DepositInput[],
    options?: Partial<AssertDepositDataOptions>,
  ) => Promise<void>;
  status: (
    pubkeys: readonly string[],
    options?: DepositStatusOptions,
  ) => Promise<DepositStatus[]>;
  prepareDeposit: (
    input: PrepareDepositInput,
  ) => Promise<Array<Prepared<'deposit'>>>;
}
```

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--fields">

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <code>fromLock</code> | <span class="sdk-type">( lock: Parameters&lt;typeof fromLock&gt;[0], options?: <a href="#FromLockOptions">FromLockOptions</a>, ) =&gt; Promise&lt;<a href="#LockDeposits">LockDeposits</a>&gt;</span> |  |
| <code>assertDepositData</code> | <span class="sdk-type">( deposits: readonly <a href="./core#DepositInput">DepositInput</a>[], options?: Partial&lt;<a href="#AssertDepositDataOptions">AssertDepositDataOptions</a>&gt;, ) =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;</span> |  |
| <code>status</code> | <span class="sdk-type">( pubkeys: readonly string[], options?: <a href="#DepositStatusOptions">DepositStatusOptions</a>, ) =&gt; Promise&lt;<a href="#DepositStatus">DepositStatus</a>[]&gt;</span> | What the beacon chain has for each pubkey: `new`, `queued` (EIP-6110 pending deposits or a pending registry entry), `active` or `exited`, with credentials, balances and epochs when known. From the Obol API, else a beacon node (`beaconUrl`), which is first checked to be on the client chain and in sync. A failed or untrusted source: STATUS_UNAVAILABLE. |
| <code>prepareDeposit</code> | <span class="sdk-type">( input: <a href="#PrepareDepositInput">PrepareDepositInput</a>, ) =&gt; Promise&lt;Array&lt;<a href="./send#Prepared">Prepared</a>&lt;'deposit'&gt;&gt;&gt;</span> | Prepares deposits via an OVM (`via: { ovm }`) or the batch deposit contract (`via: { batch: true }`). Checks the deposit data, OVM provenance (on chain) and the sender's DEPOSIT role, and, with a status source, that a `kind: 'deposit'` validator does not exist yet (DEPOSIT_VALIDATOR_EXISTS, or DEPOSIT_CONFLICT when its credentials are someone else's). Returns one [`Prepared`](./send.md#Prepared) per transaction (OVM deposits one each; one per 500 deposits via the batch contract. |

</div>
